_about: Matthew George Easton (1823-1894), Illustrated Bible Dictionary (New York: Harper & Brothers, 1893), the first edition of what Libronix sells as Easton's Bible Dictionary. The 1897 third edition has no open pre-1930 scan found. Added 2026-11-03 by lane A from Adam's Libronix inventory; Internet Archive OCR, raw; title and imprint read from the scan's title page. No uids minted. US public domain.
